messages.subject: iid model with mean vector
parts:
Dear all
    

     Hope someone can help with following question. For a study on individual preferences, I have multinomial model. I see Alligator example in volume II and used multinomial-poisson    transformation. In my linear predictor there is random effect intercept with mean vector. I used offset in  "iid" model to consider mean vector. and i used NA for reference category in offset . estimation from INLA result is overdispersion.  Is offset here ok? .and what about "NA". Linear predictor and INLA program as follows :
        
                     
log(u_ijt) = alpha_j  + \theta_it + betaX_itj
alpha is my  random intercept.

prec.alpha=0.23
yut$mu.alpha = rep(c(4,3,2.2,NA),2412)
formula=count~ -1+f(category2, model = "iid", constr = FALSE, hyper = list(prec = list(initial = log(prec.alpha),fixed = TRUE)))+
offset(mu.alpha)+
f(id, model = "iid", hyper = list(prec = list(initial = log(1e-06),fixed = TRUE)))+
f(obs, model = "iid", hyper = list(prec = list(initial = log(1e-06),fixed = TRUE)))+
C.price + C.feature

Many thanks for kindly help
   Regards
